languages.p1: polyscan Bot uses dedicated static analysis engines — pyscn for Python and jscan for JavaScript/TypeScript. They parse the AST to understand your code deeply—not just pattern matching. C++, Go, and Rust support are planned.
languages.title: Built on dedicated analyzers per language

problem.p1: AI tools like Copilot and Claude are generating more code than ever. Developers are shipping faster, but who's watching the codebase?
problem.p2: Technical debt accumulates silently. Complex functions, dead code, and duplicated logic slip through PR reviews and pile up over time.
problem.p3: You need a system that autonomously maintains your code. Not just reviewing PRs, but continuously monitoring your entire codebase.
problem.title: Code Quality in the AI Coding Era
